prof_journey.description: Building Django ERP modules with QuickBooks integration for live clients, applying DevOps skills for deployment, monitoring, and production reliability. Built a frontend API gateway, real-time alerts, a separate SendGrid email service with delivery logging, and the company website.
Led end-to-end project delivery across Python backends and JavaScript frontends. Managed full development cycles, automation tasks, and reliable client-facing releases.
Full-stack development with Python and JavaScript on AI-driven products. Worked across dental learning and compliance platforms from backend APIs to React frontends.
Built on AWS serverless, developed a Chrome extension, and maintained Laravel and Django projects. Gained early hands-on experience shipping solutions across cloud and web stacks.
Joined as a React front-end developer and moved into full-stack work across Django and healthcare portals. Took ownership of active projects and guided the team on delivery.
Junior JavaScript developer before graduation, focused on front-end fundamentals and structured JS practices. Short tenure ended early when COVID-19 disrupted operations.
Freelanced with a dedicated team during university on varied client projects. Built collaboration and problem-solving skills across different stacks and deadlines.
